title: Wiki page frontmatter
description: Documentation and editor support for wiki page frontmatter. The enforcing implementation is checks/kb.py (stdlib only, no jsonschema dependency); if the two ever disagree, checks/kb.py wins and this file is the bug.

id.description: Stable identity: <page_type>.<slug>, matching the filename. Never changes, even if the page moves.

page_type.description: Determines the directory: concepts/, entities/, topics/, claims/, questions/, syntheses/.

owner.description: Accountable team, declared in governance/owners.yaml, which must also claim this page's path.

visibility.description: Read control. Advisory in the Git layer; enforce restricted content with a separate workspace credential or RLS.

confidence.description: high requires at least one cited source with status active (captured bytes).

summary.description: One line. Rendered into wiki/index.md, so it must be scannable on its own.

sources.description: Source ids with a manifest in sources/manifests/. May be empty only for question pages and drafts.

related.description: Page ids. Must resolve; must not include this page.

supersedes.description: Page ids this page replaces. Those pages should carry status superseded.

review_required.description: Set when the change touches a path the authoring agent's team does not own.

x-body-sections.description: The body must open with an H1 and contain these level-2 sections, in this order. Write 'None known.' rather than dropping a section.

x-yaml-subset.description: Frontmatter is parsed by a stdlib-only YAML subset parser: flat 'key: value', 'key:' followed by '  - item' lists, '[]', and '#' comments. No nested maps, multi-line strings, or anchors.
